cohort: A total of 246 mothers of low birth weight or preterm infants born between January and December 2023 were selected through multistage random sampling in three regions of West Sumatra, Indonesia.
finding: Maternal postnatal depression significantly influences healthcare practices both directly and indirectly through its effect on mother-infant bonding.
followup_time: Mothers of infants aged approximately 7 to 23 months at the time of data collection.
cross-section timing: Data collection was conducted from July to December 2024, on mothers of infants born between January and December 2023.
